prompts.kirin: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART spritesheet for Vila Ninja, a top-down oblique isometric anime ninja RPG. Exactly EIGHT animation frames in a STRICT 4 columns x 2 rows equal SQUARE grid, landscape 2:1 PNG. Actual alpha transparency, no colored backdrop. Deliberate hard pixel clusters, compact limited palette, no photographic texture, no smooth painting, no blurry bloom. All complete art in each frame within x16..84%,y14..84%, LARGE EMPTY transparent gutters, never cross a cell boundary. Same registration and camera each frame. No characters, hands, text, labels, grid, scenery, checkerboard or watermark. Subject Naruto Raiton KIRIN: a massive horned draconic beast MADE OF BLUE-WHITE LIGHTNING descends from the sky and strikes the ground. Recognizable ferocious elongated dragon/kirin head with branching antler-like horns, angular snout, fierce pale eye and open toothed jaws, flowing lightning mane and tapering neck of branching electricity. Pure lightning creature, no brown skin, no physical scales, not a water dragon, no wings. Head points DOWN toward ground contact anchor x50%,y78%, slight three-quarter view. ONE-SHOT eight phases:1 small pale-blue electrical charge high above contact point;2 head begins forming out of branching arcs above;3 full horned blue lightning head high above with vertical lightning neck rising behind;4 head plunges downward with long vertical electric streak;5 head reaches ground and enormous white-blue branching strike flashes outward;6 broad bright jagged electrical ground shockwave with fading head;7 thinner diminishing ground arcs;8 sparse fading electrical wisps. Preserve distinct dragon head in phases2-5, not just generic lightning bolt. Cyan/medium-blue/pale-blue/white palette. Large strike stays entirely inside own cell. No permanent crater or soil; energy only.
